_comment: Mutation-coverage floors per crate, compared by .github/scripts/mutants-gate.py. The floor ratchets: a run may hold or improve it and may not fall below it. `target_caught_pct` is what docs/10-cross-cutting/testing.md requires for release sign-off, and it is the destination rather than the floor — a gate that failed from day one would be switched off in a week. Record a new floor with `mutants-gate.py <outcomes...> --update`, in a commit that says what was added to earn it.
